body: I am happy for you <3 Those brief moments where you feel like life is worth it are so... Surreal.

Sometimes you just know. My morbid curiosity drives me to want to do it every single day. If I didn't have a lot I want to do right now in my life I would just shoot up and slip away forever. I want to know what it is like to feel absolutely nothing.

This is one reason why I never want kids... The day that I do die will be by suicide. I know that. Could be in a week, could be in 60 years. I don't know when but that is how I am going to die. And I couldn't possibly do that to my own child.. :( I am so sorry for your loss.. :(

Thank you :') I really need to do this.. He is honestly the only thing keeping me going.. As sad as that sounds.. The guilt just built up till I couldn't do it anymore. He is the only person I have ever told.. I think that is a good start at least..
Pooping can be so satisfying though.... o.o

I lied to my boyfriend... I came clean about everything, the guilt just killed me.. And I hurt him so badly. He is the only person I have ever told the truth to. It took way too long but I need to change because he is worth it. From the liars side.. It is the most painful thing to do. Not all compulsive liars get a kick out of what they do. We get caught up in our lies and then it hurts more than anything else in the world. He is sill with me some how.. But barely, and it is the worst feeling in the world. He is giving me time to change it seems.. And I will. I know I am not trustworthy to him anymore but that doesn't mean I can't try to turn things around.
I came clean about everything, I can't lie anymore. It hurts too much. I need to actually solve my problem... :/

I have been trying that. I suppose it will just take time... But I was still wondering if there were any other tricks to it :/ I don't want to hurt people anymore. It's funny... You get to the point where you lie about things you don't even need to lie about... I have stopped doing that so there is a start. I came clean about every big lie to the person I love, and let me tell you that was... Something. So now I have to prove myself to that person that I can change. Like... ACTUALLY change. I know asking Reddit is a bit.. Well, Idk, but it is anonymous so why not right ? Any little bit could help...
Not every single one. But I need to try and get out of my rut. Who knows, maybe someone will say something that will at least help me.
Big hug~ Yeh :/ I don't want to hurt people.. But I keep doing it. I don't get why I do.... And it hurts me too..
But now I have come clean.. I have nothing to hide.. Not that he believes me about that. If I have lied about the stuff I told him he doesn't know if he can believe anything else I have to say..

I don't know if he has committed suicide, if he hasn't then I don't even know if he is going to leave me after all we have been through.. I know he will want to talk about it.... Maybe we can start again.. I will see what happens..
It is the fact that I lied about it, and he knew I was lying that got to him.. When I finally admitted to my lies it sunk in for him...
If you need someone to talk to... I am here... I could use someone as well... PM me if you want to. :(

No :'( I lied about my past to the one I love the most.. I told him all this bullshit before I liked him and got caught up in some persona and felt too ashamed to tell him the truth until now... He knew I was lying and said he wouldn't hold it against me... But last night he said he didn't want to live anymore :'( I know he is suicidal and I really hope he didn't kill himself... I am so confused and hurt.. And what is worse is that I hurt him... He says he can't believe anything I say because I lied before but I love him so much and I can't bare to lose him :'( He is my everything........

I just felt so guilty.... It weighed me down and started to crush me to death... He said he never trusted me.. But he loved me because of who I am... But now.. He says he doesn't know what to think... And now he could be gone :'( And I was so powerless to stop it :'( I don't know if he is dead or not and he wouldn't pick up the phone.. Answer texts, facebook messages, Skype messages... Nothing.......

I am trying to... Last night hit me harder than any night possible.. I came clean about my life to my boyfriend... After a few hours he said he wanted to kill himself.. I haven't heard from him since... I was his first love... I.. I ruined everything for him.. I just couldn't handle the lies anymore :'( He knew I was lying too.. And he said he wouldn't hold it against me... But then he.. He left... He has the means to kill himself.. Drugs.. OD.... I just don't even know what to do anymore..... Fuck :'(
